mode: read-only independent review; no production edits

findings.observation: Integral decimal/exponent forms 9007199254740993.0 and 9.007199254740993e15 are stored as binary64 9007199254740992.0; plain integer form correctly becomes NULL. Integer magnitudes outside binary64 finite range raise rather than preserving value_text/NULL.
findings.recommendation: Classify finite source decimals before float conversion; retain exact lexemes and abstain on nonrepresentable integral values.

findings.observation: A row whose project differs from the single-project manifest is silently skipped, with no partial-coverage signal.

CSV rows use the whole capture identity set; unlike auxiliary sources, their exact file prefix is not bound to one attempt. A source under attempt A can carry attempt B identity if B is also inventoried.
findings.recommendation: Validate rows against the owning source attempt singleton identity.

resolution: Findings delivered to owning root; resolution and final source validation are recorded separately by that owner.
